# Jane Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixteen (by end of volume 1)  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c31 P15](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0015)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c36 P23](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0023), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Jane is a plain-looking girl. She is described as good, steady, and sensible in her demeanor.

_Sources: [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Jane is a remarkably sensible, practical, and matter-of-fact girl with very little imagination. She is steady, composed, and conscientious in her work, though she can get nervous about important examinations. She holds firm, practical opinions on life and relationships, deciding early on to dedicate herself to teaching rather than marriage.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c35 P13](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0013)_

## Goals

- To become a schoolteacher and devote her life to teaching to earn a salary  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Jane Andrews grew up in Avonlea and attended the local school alongside Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and other neighborhood children. She participated in various school and community events, including the Sunday-school picnic, the story club, and the Christmas concert where she acted in the play *The Fairy Queen*. Jane was a member of Miss Stacy's Queen's Academy preparation class and successfully passed the entrance examinations. While attending Queen's Academy in Charlottetown, she took the Second Class teacher's course and excelled in domestic science. Upon obtaining her teacher's license, she was offered a position to teach at the Newbridge school.

_Sources: [v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024)_
